title: Rigorix Audit Envelope v2
description: v1 (2026-09-07) — reconciled byte-for-byte with rigorix-oss engine/src/audit/domain/envelope.rs + identity/domain/claim.rs (code is truth). Fixes vs v0 draft: EventStatus enum values now match serde output (Success|Failure|Skipped|Cancelled — no rename_all on the Rust enum); decision_context field corrected to decision_context_ref (Option<String>); $defs.approvalRecordRef/scopeViolationRef/sequencePolicyFindingRef/scoringResults completed from their structs. Canonicalization contract for HMAC (engine compute_signature): SHA-256-HMAC over serde_json::to_string(envelope with signature=None) — struct field order as declared, nulls for non-skipped Options, empty vectors/maps and None options omitted where skip_serializing_if is set. Map-typed fields (scoring_results, and each scoring result's dimensions) serialize with SORTED keys (deterministic — serde HashMap iteration order is randomized per process, which would make canonical bytes irreproducible); any independent verifier MUST reproduce this byte-exact form. ADR-015: additive `requirement_findings[]` (R9 operator step-requirement evidence; pointer names only, values never recorded). ADR-016 (Phase A): additive chain fields `producer_id` / `sequence` / `prev_hash` / `history_integrity` / `history_policy` (all serde-defaulted, omitted when absent) mirror `engine/src/audit/domain/envelope.rs` field order exactly. `prev_hash` is SHA-256 (hex) of the predecessor's canonical bytes — the SAME form the HMAC signs (`signature` nulled), so the chain and the signature can never disagree; a ledger `envelope_hash` and a checkpoint `prior_head`/`new_head` use that same value (one canonical form, no second dialect). ADR-016 (Phase C): additive `anchor_head` (the verified anchor ledger head, bound into the signed bytes in `anchored` mode; serde-defaulted, omitted when absent) mirrors `engine/src/audit/domain/envelope.rs` field order exactly — after `history_policy`, before `approval_events`. Legacy envelopes without the chain fields are grandfathered.

template_id.description: Template that generated the execution plan.

planning_hash.description: Hash of the planning prompt — replay reproducibility.

repository.description: Repository the execution ran against, e.g. my-org/my-repo.

author.description: User or bot that triggered the execution.

identity.description: Attributed human identity (ADR-012). REDACTED summary (IdentityRef::from_claim) — token_ref/auth_method/raw token never carried. Absent in pre-identity envelopes (serde skip when None).

effect_key.description: R8/ADR-014: domain-supplied canonical effect identity for this run, recorded as a one-way keyed hash — never raw parameters. Additive and serde-defaulted (omitted when absent); an envelope without it never matches an effect-keyed history rule. Entity resolution happens outside rigorix. Serialized in declared struct position when present.

events.description: Ordered execution events — node events incl. sequence_rule_matched / tool_executed.

scoring_results.description: Scored-evaluation node results keyed by node_id. Omitted when empty.

signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 hex over the canonical form (signature field nulled). null = not configured.

evidence_degraded.description: True = produced WITHOUT HMAC (explicit unsigned marker, GAP-M-12). Distinguishes intentionally-unsigned from tampered.

producer_id.description: ADR-016 / GAP-A-30 (Phase A): the chain this envelope belongs to. Additive and serde-defaulted; null/omitted in legacy (pre-chain) envelopes. All chained envelopes of one producer share it.

sequence.description: ADR-016: monotonic per-producer sequence (genesis 0). Omitted in legacy envelopes. A verifier requires contiguity from 0; an interior gap/reorder/insertion fails.

prev_hash.description: ADR-016: SHA-256 (hex) of the predecessor's canonical bytes — the SAME canonical form the HMAC signs (`signature` nulled), never a second serialization. Omitted for a producer's genesis envelope and for legacy envelopes.

history_integrity.description: ADR-016: which integrity regime produced this evidence (local_unanchored | anchored). Omitted in legacy envelopes (no integrity claim).

history_policy.description: ADR-016: the recorded `allow_unanchored` operator opt-in, when best-effort evaluation over unanchored local history was explicitly accepted. Omitted otherwise (the fail-closed default). Adds to the signed bytes, so the regime is auditable.

anchor_head.description: ADR-016 (Phase C): the verified anchor ledger head this evidence was decided against (`HistorySlice.head_hash` — the chain head the anchor attests to), bound into the signed bytes so an auditor can prove which ledger state a decision used. Present only in `anchored` mode; omitted for `local_unanchored` and legacy envelopes (serde skip when None). Serialized in the engine's declared struct position: after `history_policy`, before `approval_events`.

approval_events.description: Signed approval decisions in approval order (ADR-011 R3). Omitted when empty.

scope_violations.description: Post-execution scope violations — non-blocking evidence (ADR-011 R5). Omitted when empty.

sequence_policy_findings.description: Sequence-policy decisions recorded during the run (R6): matched rules, promoted steps, dispatch-boundary denies. Redacted summaries (SpanPrivacy). Omitted when empty.

requirement_findings.description: R9/ADR-015 operator step-requirement outcomes recorded during the run: every matched step that failed a [[requirements]] obligation — refused (deny) or approval-gated (promote). Additive and serde-defaulted, omitted when empty; pointer NAMES may be recorded, parameter VALUES never are (SpanPrivacy).

decision_context_ref.description: Reference to the decision context shown to the approver (R4 privacy pattern — full payload opt-in, stored locally). Omitted when None.

identityRef.description: Redacted claim summary from IdentityClaim (identity/domain/claim.rs). authority/expires_at are Options — always present as null when None (no serde skip).

subject.description: Human's unique identifier at the IdP.

issuer.description: Who vouches for the subject (IdP issuer URL, or "local").

source.description: IdentitySource (serde snake_case). Degradation is explicit, never a silent fallback.

event_type.description: Machine-readable type, e.g. task_completed, tool_executed, sequence_rule_matched.

correlation_id.description: Correlation across services. Omitted when None (serde skip).

status.description: EventStatus serde output — NO rename_all on the Rust enum; values are capitalized as declared.

payload.description: Event-specific details: per-node output, tool usage, budget warnings, errors. Omitted when None.

approvalRecordRef.description: Signed approval decision (ADR-011 R3). Summary fields only — full record lives in the local store.

intent_hash.description: Intent hash the approval is bound to.

node_id.description: Node id whose execution produced the violation.

out_of_scope.description: Effects outside the declared scope (from the git-diff oracle).

sequencePolicyFindingRef.description: Redacted sequence-policy finding (R6). Summary only — rule id, action, concrete matched step indices, redacted decision summary (parameter values never included).

rule_id.description: Stable id of the rule that matched.

action.description: Action taken: promote (later step paused for a human) or deny (step denied before dispatch).

later_step.description: Name of the later matched step — the step the rule gated.

matched_indices.description: Indices (into the evaluated ordered step list) of the matched steps.

summary.description: Redacted decision summary (parameter values never included).

requirementFindingRef.description: R9/ADR-015 redacted operator step-requirement finding. Summary only — the requirement id, the matched step, the action taken, the unmet obligation NAMES (pointer names and/or "identity"), and a redacted decision summary. Parameter VALUES never appear (SpanPrivacy). Derived from requirement_unmet / requirement_promoted events at envelope build time.

requirement_id.description: Stable id of the requirement that fired.

step.description: Name of the matched step that failed the requirement.

unmet.description: Unmet obligation names — required JSON-pointer names and/or "identity" (parameter values never recorded).

summary.description: Redacted decision summary (parameter values never included).

historyIntegrity.description: HistoryIntegrity (ADR-016, serde snake_case). `local_unanchored` = tamper-evident local cache only (HMAC + local chain, not anchor-authenticated); `anchored` = anchor-authenticated evidence (Phase C). NULL/absent is reserved for legacy envelopes with no integrity claim.

historyPolicy.description: HistoryPolicy (ADR-016, serde snake_case). The only value today records that the operator explicitly accepted best-effort evaluation over `local_unanchored` history instead of the fail-closed default for deny-class cross-run rules.

scoringResultRef.description: Pass/fail status, backend metadata, dimension scores — not the full raw response.

backend.description: Name of the scoring backend that produced this result.
